summary: Verified the Northern-user personalization fix end-to-end (backend + frontend/Playwright mobile viewport 390x844). Backend: 3/3 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_personalization_seed.py PASS — (1) MIGO present in /api/events with canton=Wiltz, published=true, image scraped from https://www.migo.lu/media/... (og:image ran successfully), (2) Park Sënnesräich present with canton=Clervaux (deep-dive-seed source), (3) 6 events found in Northern cantons {Wiltz, Clervaux, Vianden, Diekirch} — well above the required ≥4. Regression suite test_events_public.py 4/4 PASS. Frontend: completed the exact onboarding flow prescribed in the review (persona=family → ages=4-8 → default interests → no needs → preferredCantons=[Diekirch] → budget=any → finish). Verified persistedProfile in localStorage['lux.profile'] exactly matches: {"persona":"family","childAgeGroups":["4-8"],"interests":["playgrounds","nature","animals","workshops","culture_kids"],"needs":[],"preferredCantons":["Diekirch"],"budget":"any",...}. Events tab FOR YOU section shows top-6 = [Park Sënnesräich (Clervaux), Robbesscheier Munshausen (Clervaux), Vianden Castle + Chairlift (Diekirch), Parc Merveilleux, Programm Zooschule, Actualités - Parc Sënnesräich]. 3 of the 4 requested Northern items (Sënnesräich, Robbesscheier, Vianden) are in FOR YOU. MIGO — Mini-Golf & Indoor Playground (Wiltz) IS ranked with a positive score (cantonAffinity=0.4 confirmed: Wiltz is in NEIGHBOR_CANTONS[Diekirch]) and renders in the visible list below the FOR YOU block, but it does NOT make the top-6 FOR YOU cutoff because its interest overlap with the default family-preset (playgrounds, nature, animals, workshops, culture_kids) is only 1 category (Playgrounds), giving it a total score of ~2.2 vs. the ≥3.8 scored by the other three Northern items which match multiple interests. So the fix works — the previous bug (-0.5 demotion eliminating Northern events entirely from score>0) is truly resolved — but the review-request expectation that 'MIGO should be in FOR YOU' is only partially met.

integration_issues.flow: FOR YOU ranking for Northern user
integration_issues.issue: MIGO (Wiltz) is scored positive (~2.2 with 0.4 neighbour bonus confirmed) but is pushed out of top-6 FOR YOU by three duplicate Park Sënnesräich entries (1 deep-dive-seed + 2 crawler-imported items with title ‘Actualités - Parc Sënnesräich…’ and ‘Braddel Babbel - Le spectacle - Parc Sënnesräich…’). Consider either (a) deduping crawler-imported near-duplicates of curated deep-dive items by fuzzy title match, or (b) applying a per-venue cap of 1 in forYou.slice, or (c) increasing forYou size from 6 to ~8 so users on single-canton selections still see the marquee neighbour item. Current behaviour still solves the original bug (MIGO IS visible in the events list, previously wasn’t), but doesn’t fully meet the review’s ‘MIGO in FOR YOU’ acceptance criterion.

action_items: Backend fix is fully verified — no action required for MIGO seed or 3-northern-canton coverage.

The cantonAffinity(+0.4 for neighbours, -0.3 for far) branch is behaviourally verified: a Diekirch-only user now sees Wiltz + Clervaux + Vianden events in the ranked list. No action required on personalization.ts.

Optional (to fully match the review acceptance for ‘MIGO in FOR YOU’): dedupe crawler entries that overlap with deep-dive-seed rows (three Park Sënnesräich entries currently share the FOR YOU list); OR cap FOR YOU entries per venue/canton; OR bump slice from 6 to 8. Currently 2 of the 6 FOR YOU slots are near-duplicate Sënnesräich items, and one of them is Parc Merveilleux (Esch-sur-Alzette, far away, -0.3 canton penalty) which still outranks MIGO because it matches 3 interests.
Optional cleanup: migrate shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents to silence RN 0.76+ deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: personalization.ts:130-143 NEIGHBOR_CANTONS map is correct and symmetric for the four northern cantons (Diekirch ↔ Wiltz/Clervaux/Vianden verified). cantonAffinity returns 0.4 for Wiltz when preferred=[Diekirch] — confirmed by direct DOM inspection (MIGO with 1-interest match remained in the ranked list, i.e. score>0, which only happens if the 0.4 branch fires).

personalization.ts:178 forYou = withHits.slice(0, 6) — the 6-item hard cap combined with duplicate crawler entries is the reason MIGO is not surfaced in FOR YOU despite scoring positive. Consider a smarter selection (dedupe by title similarity, or ensure each preferred/neighbour canton has at least one representative in the top slice).

seed_deepdive.py MIGO entry (item #15) writes source_name='deep-dive-seed'. The crawler’s Park Sënnesräich rows use different source_name — they aren’t deduped against the curated one. This is the concrete cause of the FOR YOU crowding.
onboarding.tsx correctly persists preferredCantons as an array; localStorage 'lux.profile' contains the expected shape (verified via page.evaluate).

success_rate.frontend: 80% — onboarding+persistence 100% pass; FOR YOU shows 3 of the 4 requested Northern items; MIGO in ranked list but not in top-6 slice

seed_data_creation: No new seed data — relied on the /app/backend/seed_deepdive.py run that had already populated MIGO. Frontend test cleared localStorage before each run to force onboarding; no persistent test data left on the server.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The northern-user bug is functionally fixed (previously the -0.5 far-canton demotion could zero-out the total and remove events from the ranked list; now 0.4 for neighbours preserves them and MIGO/Sënnesräich/Vianden/Robbesscheier all appear on-screen for a Diekirch-only user). Backend seed is stable. If the main agent wants MIGO specifically inside FOR YOU top-6, the fix is on the ranking side (dedupe crawler duplicates of deep-dive rows, or cap per-venue in forYou.slice), not on the neighbour-canton logic. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_personalization_seed.py can be re-run any time (needs env vars: EXPO_BACKEND_URL, ADMIN_EMAIL, ADMIN_PASSWORD sourced from backend/.env).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: cantonAffinity historically returned -0.5 when a user’s preferredCantons didn’t match the event’s canton. Combined with the score>0 filter in rankForProfile, this could eliminate Northern events (Wiltz/Clervaux/Vianden) from a Diekirch-only user’s FOR YOU AND their score>0 candidate pool, making it look like the events didn’t exist. Fix in /app/frontend/src/utils/personalization.ts introduces a neighbours map so adjacent cantons score +0.4 (soft match) and far cantons only -0.3 (mild demotion, still allowing score>0 if interests match). Additionally, /app/backend/seed_deepdive.py added MIGO (item #15) so that a real Northern indoor-playground row exists in Mongo. Reproduction (post-fix): clear localStorage → onboard with only Diekirch → open Events tab → Park Sënnesräich, Robbesscheier, Vianden appear in FOR YOU; MIGO is visible further down the list (was previously invisible). Remaining nuance: MIGO doesn’t reach top-6 FOR YOU due to duplicate Sënnesräich crawler entries — not a bug in the fix itself.
